Just capture, play, and change features.

You can make easily a piece of music by an image from your camera or photo library. By image processing, an image is converted to pixel point art. The pixel view shows how many notes can you play. 

The distance between the pixels is converted music note. It's based on a mathematical process that the image converts to a number scale. You can select a scale from six number systems. Every scale has other multi music scale tones and plays a maximum of seven melodies. In addition to that, you can change the speed and the density of the pixel notes.

It supports also front and rear camera mode.

---------------------------------------

- Capture an image by the front or the rear camera. (or import from your photo library)
- Change the contrast of the image.
- Play
- Select the six music scales
- Change the density or speed.
